pages.text: $(l)$(k:hominin_evolution.item_interact)$() - work what is in your hands. One thing in each, and this is where it is made. A rock with a hammerstone opens the knapping screen instead.$(br2)Hold it with a bare stick to gnaw the end to a point.

$(l)$(k:hominin_evolution.think)$() (hold) - think. Full health and a full stomach, and it costs most of the stomach. It is how a recipe is worked out for the first time.$(br2)Once an animal has run from you, the same key holds the chase in your head instead.

$(l)$(k:hominin_evolution.social)$() - talk. Right-click one of them first and it speaks to just that one.$(br2)$(l)$(k:hominin_evolution.threat_display)$() $(l)twice$() - pant-hoot, leap and throw a fright into whatever is near. Twice, so a stray brush of the key does not set it off.

$(l)$(k:hominin_evolution.journal)$() - your journal: who you are, what is wrong with you, your band, and every skill you know.$(br2)$(l)Sneak and use$() does most of the rest:$(li)on the ground - forage$(li)on a stone deposit - take note of it$(li)on a rock or branch - throw it$(br)$(l)Use$() on water drinks from it.

Climbing needs no key at all. Walk into a trunk and you go up it; look down and hold back to come down.$(br2)Sleep in a nest, not on the floor - and it has to be a finished one, six armfuls in a two-by-three.

$(l)Tips$() come when something new comes up - the first time your water runs low, the first time something hunts you - once each, as a card in the corner and a line in chat. Double-click the line in chat and this book opens at the page it is about.$(br2)$(l)/hominin tips off$() turns them off, $(l)on$() back on, and $(l)reset$() lets them all come again.
